sloka: तद्व्यर्थं शिखरं दृष्ट्वा द्रुमवर्षं महाकपिः।विससर्ज रणे तस्मिन् रावणस्य सुतं प्रति ।। ६.७०.३५ ।।
transliteration: tadvyarthaṁ śikharaṁ dṛṣṭvā drumavarṣaṁ mahākapiḥ।visasarja raṇe tasmin rāvaṇasya sutaṁ prati ।। 6.70.35 ।।

translations.english: Then seeing that the top of the mountain hurled was ineffective in that battle over Ravana's son, Hanuman discharged rain of trees.
